name: braces
reason: Transitive build-time dependency bundled inside @ducanh2912/next-pwa -> workbox-build -> fast-glob -> micromatch. Only invoked during Next.js service worker compilation; never processes user-controlled regex patterns at runtime.

name: micromatch
reason: Transitive dependency inside workbox-build via fast-glob; build-time service worker generation only.

name: fast-glob
reason: Transitive dependency inside workbox-build; build-time service worker asset globbing only.

name: @ducanh2912/next-pwa
reason: Next.js PWA generation plugin. Vulnerability is in upstream Google Workbox build toolchain, which has not yet published an updated major release.

name: postcss
reason: CSS sourceMappingURL parsing vulnerability bundled in Next.js build-time pipeline. Build-time compilation only; no arbitrary CSS or source maps from untrusted users are processed at runtime.

name: serialize-javascript
reason: Transitive dependency in workbox-build and terser used during webpack service-worker minification. Only runs on static application code during npm run build.
